'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw LS Local Trouble''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Local Trouble / No Match For A Jedi]]
* '''Username:''' STEALTHEBLIND
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
